svg.text: SB-ISPGM / RBIM - Level 1 Data Flow Diagram
Municipality of Tomas Oppus | Resident, Barangay Secretary and Municipal DILG
Rectangle = external entity | Circle = process | Parallel lines = data store | Arrow = direction of data flow
Repeated E / D identifiers refer to the same entities and stores. Data stores group related database records and protected files.
Core business flows only. Shared authentication, activity logging and email transport details are omitted for readability.
